# LightColor

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Lights](Blitz3D-Lights)

</div>


```blitzbasic
LightColor:Void light:Int32, red:Float32, green:Float32, blue:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `light` | In | Int32 | required | Light handle. |
| `red` | In | Float32 | required | Red part of the light. |
| `green` | In | Float32 | required | Green part of the light. |
| `blue` | In | Float32 | required | Blue part of the light. |

## Description

Sets the color of the light. 255, 255, 255 is full white light, 0, 0, 0 adds nothing. The original accepts values from -255 to 255 where negative values darken what the light touches, which lets you fake shadows.
